title: Snow Plow – Free Christmas Driving Game (One Button)
description: Play Snow Plow free in your browser: hold to drive a snow plow and push a pile of presents over snowy hills to Santa's sleigh.
body: Santa's sleigh is waiting and the road is buried in snow. Hold to drive your little orange snow plow, release to brake, and push the pile of presents in front of the blade all the way to the sleigh.

Every present that reaches a sleigh is one point. A sleigh waits every 150 m and gives you five fresh presents, so a careful driver can keep going for a long time. Lose every present and the run is over.
One button, no text, runs of one to three minutes, and it works on phones, tablets, Chromebooks and desktops. New here? Read how to play and the tips to deliver more presents.

title: How to Play Snow Plow – Controls and Rules
description: Snow Plow controls in one line: hold to drive, release to brake. Learn how presents, sleighs, ice and the score work.
body: Snow Plow uses a single input. Hold the mouse button, your finger or the Space bar to drive forward. Release to brake. In the air, holding tips the truck back and releasing tips it forward.

You start with a pile of six presents in front of the yellow blade. Push them along the road: a present that slips over the blade and stays behind it, or tumbles away, is lost. The number in the top left corner shows how many presents you still have in front of you.

Every 150 m there is a red sleigh with a candy-cane pole. Each present that crosses the pole goes into Santa's sack and adds one to your score (the big number at the top). The bar under the score shows how close the next sleigh is.
When the first present arrives, the elves leave five new presents on the road just after the sleigh. Push them on to the next one.

The run ends when there are no presents left in front of the blade, or if the truck stays upside down. Your best score is saved automatically, together with the total number of presents you have delivered.

title: Snow Plow Tips: Deliver More Presents to Santa
description: Practical tips for Snow Plow: how to keep the pile together on hills, bumps and ice, and when to let go of the button.
body: Slow is fast. At full speed the top presents bounce over the blade. A steady push keeps the pile together and still reaches the sleigh in time.
Ease off at the top of a hill. Going down, the presents slide ahead on their own. Release a little so the blade stays right behind them instead of ramming them.
Bumps shake the pile. Over a row of snow bumps, short taps beat holding the whole way.
Ice is the shiny blue strip. Your wheels spin and the presents slide on it. Arrive slowly, keep a light touch and let momentum carry you across.
Small jumps, small risks. Before a ramp, let go so you do not launch the presents into the air.
Five presents per sleigh. The refill is the same every time, so every present you save between sleighs is a bonus point. Losing one early is not the end: keep pushing the rest.

title: Snow Plow FAQ
description: Answers about Snow Plow: is it free, does it save, does it work on mobile and Chromebook, why did my run end.
body: Is it free? Yes, it is free to play in the browser, with no download and no account.
Does it save my progress? Yes. Your best score, your longest distance and the total number of presents you have delivered are stored in your browser.
Does it work on phones and Chromebooks? Yes, with touch, mouse or keyboard (Space, Up, Right, W or D), in landscape or portrait.
Why did my run end? Either every present slipped behind the blade or rolled away, or the truck stayed upside down for more than a second.
What are the blue strips on the road? Ice. Wheels and presents slide on it, so cross it slowly.
Can I turn the music off? Yes, with the speaker button in the top right corner.

title: Snow Plow: a Christmas Game for Kids – No Text, No Chat
description: A festive one-button driving game for kids and classrooms: deliver presents to Santa's sleigh. No reading, no chat, no purchases.
h1: A Christmas game for kids: Snow Plow
body: Snow Plow is a short Christmas game: a friendly snow plow pushes wrapped presents through a snowy night to Santa's sleigh. There is no violence, no chat, no purchases, no account and no personal data.
There is no text in the game, only numbers and pictures, so children who are still learning to read can play it, and it works the same in any language.

It is also a playful lesson in physics: push too hard and the pile topples, go too fast downhill and the presents run away, drive onto ice and nothing grips. Kids learn to plan ahead and to control speed.

Runs last one to three minutes, which makes it a good reward at the end of a lesson before the winter holidays. It runs in the browser on Chromebooks, tablets and phones and loads in a couple of seconds (1.6 MB in total).
